description:
TalNexis gives your AI assistant real-time hiring intelligence across 98 top tech companies — Anthropic, Nvidia, Stripe, Anduril, Snowflake, and more. Data is scraped daily from public job boards.

Ask about top hiring movers, AI/ML role trends, company-specific signals, or sector-level pulse. Tools cover market summaries, hiring velocity, role category breakdowns, and detected signals like AI hiring surges and functional shifts.

Connect via the hosted SSE endpoint — no local setup required.
